import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv(pd.compat.StringIO("""amount,is_fraud,transaction_type,hour_of_day
115.02,0,refund,22
44.37,0,payment,5
144.25,0,transfer,21
536.22,0,payment,17
38.43,0,payment,5"""))

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Transaction Data Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Transaction Amount Distribution by Type
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
transaction_types = data['transaction_type'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(transaction_types))
for i, trans_type in enumerate(transaction_types):
    trans_data = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]['amount']
    ax1.scatter([trans_type] * len(trans_data), trans_data, s=100, alpha=0.6, color=colors[i], label=trans_type)
ax1.set_xlabel('Transaction Type', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Transaction Amounts by Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Transaction Distribution by Hour of Day
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
hour_counts = data.groupby('hour_of_day').size()
ax2.bar(hour_counts.index, hour_counts.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Transactions', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Transactions by Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 3. Transaction Type Distribution (Pie Chart)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
type_counts = data['transaction_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(type_counts))
ax3.pie(type_counts.values, labels=type_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors_pie, startangle=90, textprops={'fontsize': 10})
ax3.set_title('Transaction Type Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Amount vs Hour with Transaction Type
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
for trans_type in transaction_types:
    trans_data = data[data['transaction_type'] == trans_type]
    ax4.scatter(trans_data['hour_of_day'], trans_data['amount'], 
               s=150, alpha=0.6, label=trans_type, edgecolors='black', linewidth=1)
ax4.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Transaction Amount vs Hour of Day', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Type', fontsize=9)
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
